description: A Dart class defining the core data model for a recipe, including properties, constructors, serialization, and query methods.

classes.name: Recipe
classes.description: Immutable data model representing a recipe with properties like id, title, imageUrl, ingredients, steps, durationMinutes, servings, and tags. Includes methods for querying, copying, serialization, and deserialization.

methods.name: matchesQuery
methods.description: Checks if the recipe matches a search query against its title, ingredients, or tags, case-insensitive.

methods.name: hasTag
methods.description: Checks if the recipe has a specific tag, case-insensitive.

methods.name: copyWith
methods.description: Creates a copy of the recipe with optional modified fields.

methods.name: toMap
methods.description: Converts the recipe to a JSON-compatible map.

methods.name: fromMap
methods.description: Creates a recipe instance from a JSON-compatible map, tolerant to dynamic list types.

methods.name: toJsonString
methods.description: Serializes the recipe to a JSON string.

methods.name: fromJsonString
methods.description: Creates a recipe instance from a JSON string.
